==Walkthrough==
===Entering the house===
{{Checklist|*Talk to the [[Boy]] south-east of the long garden in [[Taverley]], next to the members gate. {{Chat option|1What's the matter?|1Ok, I'll see what I can do.}}
*Head west, then north to the front door of the [[witch's house (location)|house]], across from the [[player-owned house]] portal.
*Look-under the potted plant closest to the door for a [[Door key (Witch's House)|door key]] and enter the door.
*Read the Diary on the table
*Climb down the ladder to the north, equip gloves, and enter the [[gate (witch's house)|gate]]. (The [[boxes (witch's house)|boxes]] can be searched for a pair of [[leather gloves]].)
*Equip your leather gloves before opening the gate.
*Search the [[cupboard (witch's house)|cupboard]] for a [[Magnet (Witch's House)|magnet]].
*Climb up the ladder and go to the small southern room.
*Drop cheese in the room and a [[Mouse (Witch's House)|mouse]] will come out.
*'''QUICKLY''' use the magnet on the mouse.}}

===Retrieving the ball===
{{Checklist|*Go around the garden to the [[fountain (witch's house)|fountain]] without being caught by the [[Nora T. Hagg|Witch]]. (Full run energy or a [[stamina potion]] may be useful.)
**Note: Use the hedges, getting caught means repeating all previous steps except for getting the door key. You '''cannot''' walk over the grass.
*Check the fountain.
*Go to the shed on the east and use the key on the door.
**'''Warning:''' Attempting to take the ball now makes the [[Witch's experiment]] lower your combat stats.'''
*Kill the Witch's experiment in all four forms.
**Low levels can use the north-eastern corner to step under the first and second forms of the Witch's experiment until it goes north where it is safespottable with magic 1 tile south-west.
**The third and fourth forms can be safespotted in the south of the shed past the ball.}}

===Finishing up===
{{Checklist|*Take the [[ball]].
*Leave the Witch's house by teleporting out, or by exiting through the garden then the front door.
**Do not get caught or you will have to get the ball again. If the ball does not spawn when you lose it, hop worlds.
*Go back to the boy and give him the ball.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
